profile_text.body:
Alphabet is a public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. It trades under the ticker GOOGL and its corporate website is abc.xyz, which the company presents as its investor relations home. Its SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001652044.

The material available on the company's own site is limited to that investor relations landing page, so there is little description of products or AI work to report from it. No products are tracked for Alphabet in the current record, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are listed. The record does show 281 legal matters in California.
